issue.title: Block ID Picker: show project-note filename availability for @route^id+

task_type_fields.proposal:
When the Block ID Picker's New ID composer is in `project_note` intent (`@route^id+` or `@route:id+`), show whether the project note `<route>_<id with '-' replaced by '_'>.md` already exists, so a collision is visible before capture rather than only as a red live-preview error.

Today `bob capture-complete` returns `block_id.intent = "project_note"` with `used: []` (verified on bob-cli master 271cadd with `@sase:x+`, cursor 7), so the composer has no availability signal for this intent. Proposed: add an additive field to the `block_id` object for project-note intent (for example the target relative path and whether it exists), have the Mac composer's availability badge and detail strip use it, and cover it with real-bob fixtures in bob-mac-capture. The filename rule is documented in bob-cli docs/capture.md (search "The filename is `<route>_").
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The approved bob-cli-2h plan (plan:202609/mac_block_id_picker.md, Design decision 8) listed project-note filename availability as out of scope and asked for it to be recorded as a proposed follow-up. The epic ships ID availability against used block IDs only.

issue.creation_reason: Recorded by the bob-cli-2h land agent from that epic's approved plan (Design decision 8), which named project-note filename availability as an out-of-scope follow-up.
